info.title: ProbeAtlas API
info.description:
ProbeAtlas measures availability and latency of public internet endpoints from
operator-placed monitoring agents.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
* API keys (`pak_...`) are bound to one workspace.
* Session tokens (`pas_...`, from `/v1/auth/login`) also need an `X-Workspace-Id` header.

**Pagination.** List endpoints return `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`.
Pass `cursor=<next_cursor>` to get the next page; `next_cursor` is `null` on the last page.

**Errors.** Every error has the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.
Validation errors use HTTP 422 and code `validation_error` with per-field `details`.

**Rate limits.** Requests are limited per workspace (default 300/minute) and
authentication endpoints per client IP. Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429 with
code `rate_limited` and a `Retry-After` header.

**Units.** Durations in milliseconds, percentages 0-100, timestamps UTC ISO 8601.
Fields that do not apply or were not measured are `null`.

post.description:
Create an account and a first workspace, and return a session.

Rate limited per client IP. Returns 403 when registration is disabled and 409 if the email is taken.

Exchange email and password for a session token.

Rate limited per client IP. Unknown emails and wrong passwords get the same 401 response and the same
hashing cost, so the endpoint does not reveal which accounts exist.

get.description: Return the signed-in user and their workspaces (session tokens only).
List the workspaces the signed-in user belongs to (session tokens only).

schema.title: Response List Workspaces V1 Workspaces Get

post.description: Create a workspace owned by the signed-in user (at most 10 owned workspaces).

get.description: List the members of the current workspace and their roles.

schema.title: Response List Members V1 Members Get

post.description: Add a registered user to the workspace by email (owner only).

delete.description: Remove a member from the workspace (owner only). The last owner cannot be removed.

get.description: List the workspace's API keys, newest first. Secrets are never returned.

schema.title: Response List Keys V1 Api Keys Get

post.description: Create an API key (owner session only). The secret is returned once in ``key``.

delete.description: Revoke an API key immediately. Revoking an already revoked key is a no-op.

post.description: Revoke the key immediately and issue a replacement with the same name and expiry policy.

get.description: List monitors, newest first, optionally filtered by state and type. Cursor-paginated.

post.description:
Create a monitor. Checks are scheduled immediately unless ``paused`` is true.

Validates type-specific settings, workspace limits, region availability, and the target against the
outbound network policy.

get.description: Get one monitor and its current state.

patch.description:
Partially update a monitor. Every change increments ``config_version``.

Jobs that are already scheduled keep the configuration they were created with.

delete.description: Delete the monitor together with its jobs, results, rules, and incidents.

post.description: Pause a monitor: stop scheduling checks and cancel pending jobs.
Resume a paused monitor and schedule a check immediately.

get.description: Compare a monitor across regions and agents over a time window (default: last 24h).

Bucketed availability and latency history for a monitor (default: last 24h).

Group by ``region``, ``agent``, or ``none``. The bucket size is chosen automatically unless
``bucket_seconds`` is given.
Incident events and configuration changes for this monitor, newest first.

schema.title: Response Monitor Events V1 Monitors  Monitor Id  Events Get

get.description: Raw measurement history, newest first, filtered to the caller's workspace.

parameters.name: since

schema.description: Inclusive lower bound on measured_at (default: 24h ago).
schema.title: Since

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on measured_at (default: 24h ago).

parameters.name: until

schema.description: Exclusive upper bound on measured_at (default: now).
schema.title: Until

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on measured_at (default: now).

get.description: List the workspace's alert rules, optionally for one monitor.

schema.title: Response List Rules V1 Alert Rules Get

post.description:
Create an alert rule for a monitor.

``http_status`` rules apply only to HTTP monitors and ``packet_loss`` rules only to ICMP monitors. A
monitor can have at most 20 rules.

get.description: Get one alert rule and the regions where it is firing.

patch.description: Update an alert rule's threshold, hysteresis, minimum regions, or enabled flag.

delete.description: Delete an alert rule together with its incidents and streak state.

get.description: List incidents, newest first, optionally filtered by status and monitor. Cursor-paginated.
Get an incident with its full event timeline.
List the workspace's notification channels. Signing secrets are not included.

schema.title: Response List Channels V1 Notification Channels Get

post.description:
Create a webhook channel (owner only). The response includes the signing secret once.

The URL must be http(s) and resolve to a public address. At most 10 channels per workspace.

patch.description: Update a channel's name, URL, or enabled flag (owner only).

delete.description: Delete a notification channel and its pending deliveries (owner only).

post.description: Send a signed test payload synchronously and report the receiver's response.

get.description: List recent notification deliveries with their status and last error.

schema.title: Response List Deliveries V1 Notification Deliveries Get

get.description: Platform measurement agents visible to all workspaces. Locations are operator-configured.

schema.title: Response List Agents V1 Agents Get

get.description: Regions that monitors can select, with current agent availability.

schema.title: Response List Locations V1 Locations Get

get.description:
Everything the main dashboard shows, in one request.

``latency`` and per-region latency cover HTTP checks only, so that DNS,
TCP, and ICMP timings are not mixed into one distribution.
List the workspace audit log, newest first (owner only).

schema.title: Response Audit Events V1 Audit Events Get

post.description: Exchange an enrollment token for a long-lived agent identity.

Record an agent heartbeat and refresh its version, capabilities, and status.

An agent marked offline becomes ``online`` again on its next heartbeat. Disabled agents are rejected.

Lease up to ``max_jobs`` due jobs in the agent's region that it is able to run.

Each job must be reported before its ``lease_expires_at``; otherwise it may be retried by another agent.

Submit measurement results for leased jobs.

Each result is acknowledged as ``accepted``, ``duplicate`` (already stored; safe to drop), or
``rejected`` with a reason. Tenant and target are taken from the job, never from the payload.

get.description: Liveness probe: the process is up. Does not touch the database.
Readiness probe: the database answers ``SELECT 1``.

AgentOut.title: AgentOut
AgentOut.description: A monitoring agent. Location fields are labels configured by the operator, not verified.

AgentRegistration.title: AgentRegistration

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: ms for latency, percent for packet_loss.

AlertRuleCreate.title: AlertRuleCreate
AlertRuleCreate.description: Create an alert rule for a monitor in the caller's workspace.

AlertRuleOut.title: AlertRuleOut
AlertRuleOut.description: An alert rule and the regions in which it is currently firing.

AlertRuleUpdate.title: AlertRuleUpdate
AlertRuleUpdate.description: Partial update of an alert rule. ``kind`` and ``monitor_id`` are immutable.

ApiKeyCreate.title: ApiKeyCreate
ApiKeyCreate.description: Create an API key. Keys never expire unless ``expires_in_days`` is set.

key.title: Key
key.description: The secret. Shown only once; store it securely.

ApiKeyIssued.title: ApiKeyIssued
ApiKeyIssued.description: A newly created or rotated API key, including the secret ``key`` (shown only once).

ApiKeyOut.title: ApiKeyOut
ApiKeyOut.description: An API key's metadata. The secret is never returned after creation.

AuditEventOut.title: AuditEventOut
AuditEventOut.description: A security-relevant action recorded in the workspace audit log.

ChannelCreate.title: ChannelCreate
ChannelCreate.description: Create a webhook notification channel. The URL must be a public http(s) URL.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for X-ProbeAtlas-Signature. Shown only once.

ChannelIssued.title: ChannelIssued
ChannelIssued.description: A newly created channel, including its HMAC ``signing_secret`` (shown only once).

ChannelOut.title: ChannelOut
ChannelOut.description: A notification channel. The signing secret is never returned after creation.

ChannelTestResult.title: ChannelTestResult
ChannelTestResult.description: Outcome of sending a test event to a channel.

ChannelUpdate.title: ChannelUpdate
ChannelUpdate.description: Partial update of a notification channel.

CheckType.title: CheckType
CheckType.description: Measurement protocols an agent can execute. Values are stable wire identifiers.

ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest
ClaimRequest.description: Body of ``POST /agent/v1/jobs/claim``: how many jobs the agent can run right now.

ClaimResponse.title: ClaimResponse
ClaimResponse.description: Jobs leased to the agent. Each must be executed and reported before its lease expires.

DeliveryOut.title: DeliveryOut
DeliveryOut.description: One notification delivery and its status (``pending``, ``sent``, or ``failed``).

FailureCategory.title: FailureCategory
FailureCategory.description:
Stable, machine-readable reason a measurement failed.

Categories are part of the public API (dashboards, alert rules, and the ``failure_category`` filter rely
on them). Add new values; never rename existing ones.

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: Jobs that expired without a result (no data, not success).

GroupPerformance.title: GroupPerformance
GroupPerformance.description: Availability and latency for one group of results: overall, one region, or one agent.

IncidentDetail.title: IncidentDetail
IncidentDetail.description: An incident with its full timeline.

IncidentEventOut.title: IncidentEventOut
IncidentEventOut.description: A timeline entry of an incident.

IncidentOut.title: IncidentOut
IncidentOut.description: An incident: a period during which an alert rule was firing.

JobSpec.title: JobSpec
JobSpec.description: A measurement assignment handed to an agent.

sample_count.title: Sample Count
sample_count.description: Successful samples with a latency value.

LatencyStats.title: LatencyStats
LatencyStats.description: Latency statistics over successful samples. Percentiles are null when there are too few samples.

LocationOut.title: LocationOut
LocationOut.description: A selectable monitoring region with the agents currently serving it.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: Email and password login. Returns a session token.

MeOut.title: MeOut
MeOut.description: The signed-in user and the workspaces they belong to.

MeasurementOut.title: MeasurementOut
MeasurementOut.description:
One raw measurement result (schema version 1).

Durations are milliseconds; fields that do not apply to the check type or were not measured are null.
``measured_at`` comes from the agent and ``ingested_at`` from the control plane; ``late`` marks results
that arrived after the job lease.

MemberAdd.title: MemberAdd
MemberAdd.description: Add an existing user, by email, to the workspace with a role.

MemberOut.title: MemberOut
MemberOut.description: A member of a workspace and their role.

latency_threshold_ms.title: Latency Threshold Ms
latency_threshold_ms.description: Successful checks slower than this mark the monitor degraded.

target.title: Target
target.description: URL for http, hostname or IP otherwise.

MonitorCreate.title: MonitorCreate
MonitorCreate.description:
Create a monitor.

``settings`` depends on ``type``: see ``HttpSettings``, ``DnsSettings``, ``TcpSettings``, and
``IcmpSettings``. Targets that resolve to private or internal addresses are rejected.

MonitorEvent.title: MonitorEvent
MonitorEvent.description: An entry in a monitor's recent-events feed, from incidents or the audit log.

MonitorOut.title: MonitorOut
MonitorOut.description:
A monitor and its current state.

``state`` is ``unknown`` (no recent data), ``up``, ``degraded`` (some regions failing or slow), ``down``
(all regions failing), or ``paused``.

MonitorUpdate.title: MonitorUpdate
MonitorUpdate.description: Partial update. ``type`` is immutable; recreate the monitor to change it.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description:
Dashboard summary for the workspace over ``window_hours``.

``availability_pct`` is null when there are no results in the window.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: healthy | incomplete (a region missed at least half of its checks) | degraded (single region) | regional | global | no_data, from per-region success rate and missing checks.

slow_regions.title: Slow Regions
slow_regions.description: Regions whose P50 is more than 2x the median P50 of the others.

RegionalPerformance.title: RegionalPerformance
RegionalPerformance.description: Comparison of a monitor's performance across regions and agents for a time window.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description: Create an account and its first workspace. Passwords must be 10-256 characters.

ResultAck.title: ResultAck
ResultAck.description:
Per-result outcome of a submission.

``accepted`` means stored, ``duplicate`` means the result or job was already recorded (safe to drop), and
``rejected`` means it will never be accepted (for example a job leased to another agent); ``reason``
explains why.

ResultBatch.title: ResultBatch
ResultBatch.description: Body of ``POST /agent/v1/results``: up to 200 measurement results.

ResultBatchResponse.title: ResultBatchResponse
ResultBatchResponse.description: Acknowledgements for a :class:`ResultBatch`, one per submitted result.

SessionOut.title: SessionOut
SessionOut.description: A new session token (shown once) with the user and their workspaces.

Timeseries.title: Timeseries
Timeseries.description: Bucketed history for a monitor. Buckets without results are omitted, not zero-filled.

TimeseriesPoint.title: TimeseriesPoint
TimeseriesPoint.description: Aggregates for one time bucket. ``t`` is the bucket start (UTC).

TimeseriesSeries.title: TimeseriesSeries
TimeseriesSeries.description: Points for one group (a region, an agent id, or ``all``).

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: Public profile of a user account.

WorkspaceCreate.title: WorkspaceCreate
WorkspaceCreate.description: Create another workspace owned by the caller.

WorkspaceOut.title: WorkspaceOut
WorkspaceOut.description: A workspace and its limits. ``role`` is the caller's role when listed for a user.
